items.metric: Samples shipped (worst decline this week, the gate before creator content)

items.effect: Streams rose to 121 from 103 while LIVE GMV halved, so yield per stream fell to 1.47 from 3.64.
items.action: Re-brief the creators holding the top streams and hold stream count near 100 until yield per stream clears 3.

items.metric: Video views (fell with posting volume and per video reach)
items.effect: Videos posted fell to 58 from 92 and views per video slipped 5.7% to 3,556.8, so reach lost on both volume and per video yield.
items.action: Hold video output near 90 posts per week and rebuild reach from the winning hooks in creative_brief.json.

items.metric: Creators posting (third week of decline, with Affiliate GMV down 25.0% to 2,515.86)
items.effect: Third week down with Affiliate GMV falling in step, so the loss is creator breadth rather than basket size, GMV per posting creator rose to 124.62 from 82.71.
items.action: Reactivate the creators who posted in the prior week and route new approvals to creators with live post history.
